svg.title: Benzoin condensation: Internal proton inventory redistribution
svg.desc: PhC(O–H)(CN)–CH(O−)Ph → PhC(O−)(CN)–CH(OH)Ph. A solvent-mediated proton relay transfers the original OH proton to the newly formed alkoxide; no free proton is implied.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
A solvent-mediated proton relay transfers the original OH proton to the newly formed alkoxide; no free proton is implied.
